## Design

### 2026-10-27: In this session, I sketched up a basic design of what I want the finished product to look like.

**4h**

In this session, I sketched up a basic design of what I want the finished product to look like.

![WIN_20261027_17_43_37_Pro](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/25da06aed61e53ce6539c591e995799f44cda44a09f0953a89c1a69c265b032f.jpg)

It will include a PCB on the bottom, with a mesh for the panels to rest on, and the acrylic panels. These parts will fit together tightly, so the design will take some iterations. I used Makercase to make-a-case for the bottom bit.

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 171836](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/78c0581afd54a64b52a8cc7100f3d3066b83a18800979ed85b5da6949f7f76e3.png)

 I tried using Canva and then Fusion360 to put a hole in one the panels but they both had issues with the case size changing.

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 173238](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/d4470487af80ed06d8e4a1594a04d0fb16d76c26c7e0f143dd15275d7c4bb470.png)

I decided to use Inkscape which didn't give me an accurate size of the hole, but kept dimensions the same. The hole is for the  USB cable that will give the board power.

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 173502](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/686a280bebc7f01bcbbc06deae5d92da42bc1ae2bc394ce299c72b0314791d7d.png)

I also contacted my local makerspace in the city library to ask about acrylic laser cutting. I should be able to do it pretty cheaply if I supply the acrylic. I then also had a look at acrylic and it is looking pretty expensive, meaning I will probably need to go for a higher tier of funding.

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 175703](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/8b3b19baf8b7603b7f6d76e070ab8c24c377591e58e819dfafbebc0674035694.png)

### 2026-10-28: In this session, I created a 3D design of the base in Fusion360 to replace the lasercut one. I did this because it needs complicated slots and cuts to hold the acrylic panels. It also needs to be gene

**5h**

In this session, I created a 3D design of the base in Fusion360 to replace the lasercut one. I did this because it needs complicated slots and cuts to hold the acrylic panels. It also needs to be generally accurate and 3D printing will allow me to easily change the design if necessary. With lasercutting, I have to wait 3 weeks because of a long wait list. I went through a few design iterations before engineering the final design. I am going to run through them here:

Version 1: This version is a basic box with an opening that is very similar to the laser cut design but has a few holes for rods to go through and support the acrylic. This meant that the LEDs wouldn't shine up through the acrylic equally which could cause some looks issues. It also meant that light could easily shine between the panels, making it harder to see the difference between the text. It needed some updates.

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 172513](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/8072487ed85ae701838df28bc2c0edaff157d8a09262836d657df4285b7df650.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 172518](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/1a5db3796f8caf114ffbaf349875bddcf1d04d471a8b71af1a0822de3259012d.png)

Version 2: This version was the same as Version 1 but had slots for the acrylic to sit on. I included the beams because I thought it would keep it up. With this design, the light could still shine between the panels, and the LEDs couldn't be equally placed.

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 173032](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/2048891e0001cfcd9eeb899d8355d5bb596066f122a800a8ad93ae15248157cf.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 173617](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/f1c583685b1bf2808cc2b66dd5862607f9fadbd0fd2e1c8f93d71788948b926f.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 174425](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/939a9e985cc5e57402ba9a1b9c10ff5149693cecc932c64490830691abd2e73e.png)

Version 3: I added slot guides to keep the acrylic at a right angle to the box. This meant that the previous beams were unnecessary and just taking up space so I removed them. This  design makes it look like a toaster which is kind of fun. It also means that I can swap the position of the panels to change the effect. That is an added bonus that would work very easily with this design.

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 174519](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/5d31879f60cbabe9feb0f7f6beec0066635e996393d26cad884858b77a875b99.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 174901](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/b8d31e760f09631c0a191039312e009a9143537be5df809af89765a1d35bb43c.png)

I also added some text with the project's name in an empty space I had on one side.

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 175245](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/d7d1db90e2d63ea826ccb8b697bfed993d99e196450687f68bbd6ad6f9f387a5.png)

Here is the finished design!

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 190609](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/d948ebfcd7b0840076814dfc0c2eee606f1b5c5c8b35e97e342cf7b26c37ce18.png)

I also found some acrylic that will almost exactly fit my needs for it. It's also cheap compared to my previous option, so maybe I will be down a tier? I am not sure, really...

![Screenshot 2026-10-28 174956](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/f22b83c5b15f3a9bc5a39b1fd7115cd118f3d9d31e98bd1a93150a1b5041d0b2.png)

### 2026-10-31: I created the schematic and arranged parts for the PCB in EasyEDA pro.

**4h**

I created the schematic and arranged parts for the PCB in EasyEDA pro.

In my first go at a schematic, I made the same mistake as in my Hexbie and used a common library resistor and LED. These work well for manufacturing but don't have holes and instead have pads. That would make it very difficult to solder on to.

### 2026-10-31: I took out the quickly done routes that I had done last session so that I could think about how to do them properly. Seeing as there are two copper layers, I decided that it would make sense to have o

**4h**

I took out the quickly done routes that I had done last session so that I could think about how to do them properly. Seeing as there are two copper layers, I decided that it would make sense to have one for 5V and one for GND.
I started by connecting all of the LED bars, which were the same across sets.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 102647](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/eddcc25a99c2bf5a8f44cb017551ba91bba2b60c7402c788e081c10ed60a656d.png)

Once I had done that I routed the GND lines that would hold the connections. I kept them to one side so that if I needed some tracks to go under others, they would be able to.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 103101](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/92e1e97e758e35f51be543a94a41d213fbf8657317144fb717260c2f3bc62d72.png)

Then, I connected them.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 103358](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/0e1aa24b3b8a705a6c9081c5c6f41562f8a57da92d245b8ee01cc6ce5001cc48.png)

I rearranged the top resistor slots because I needed the further down ones on the outside. Then I could track them along each other until they reach their spot.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 104613](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/0471f83605a7db6ce85bfb83148f89a7d041ce4802770b8b05cb353014224933.png)

I then did that for the other side.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 105024](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/df0c05c7eed94ded6942ec80b9efdb312f2ba62dd66eee7d264e4ed890db4247.png)

I then ordered my PCB on JLCPCB to make sure that it will arrive in time. It didn't cost much at all because I was able to get $10 USD off of the order cost. I also used the slowest shipping which will work as I only need it in 5 weeks.

### 2026-11-01: I designed the acrylic slices in Fusion360 and exported them as a .svg file for laser cutting. The sketch I made in fusion contained all of the information, and it was the only thing in the history ba

**5h**

I designed the acrylic slices in Fusion360 and exported them as a .svg file for laser cutting. The sketch I made in fusion contained all of the information, and it was the only thing in the history bar other than the extrude after. Here are some photos from the designing:

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 153014](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/42330ae26008e76c7962021affec24f4cb6780f816251329a113ea0334371040.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 153838](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/20422e3e9c18e8cd439adcd9f0704a51a0c897017915367e350fb3b2c1600be2.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 154836](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/ff577e33f5d8df5046480a401963f4cd74f9490c9c292fb710ce2cb2be12695f.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 155516](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/e7b840eb7fa526b3ccaaa959d792d7492607745830c059d94f0eac583a806dd8.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 163205](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/98231f8c798848ab5afd15fb9e4921c3686c1bf15339eb60fb14c7b4db9f927d.png)

There are 3 effects that I included on my slices:
The first is a collection of squares with 3 variants, showing their position change through the slices.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 171407](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/d2b221685a28873cdcd05f7b260de5e28ab42593bef3a18cba4c35c9939bba76.png)

The next effect is the pair of circles at the top. They are bigger or smaller depending on which slice you view, and they should make cone shape when put together. There are two so you can have a forward facing cone and a backwards facing cone.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 171619](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/2649a2c278724a00f1371329d8ab82a7df239f95dd750edaaa06e4e546c9e2a5.png)

The final thing is a series of cross sections from a cube at an interesting angle, making the middle on a hexagon. I estimated the size on these, so hopefully they look good.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 171713](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/36661791d1bdf1c872624e1622d1ba3c26a31557202d3fdd16d98db5b3d61a3f.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 171716](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/e8f21ca9adb233466c5b6f2efba9ee0270f25a99d2c7423165090428eeb489cc.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 171719](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/dcb7ac97a390abce108f351432d50068d7606f1ebe7771c1dc5102ae30552bf8.png)

Here is an image of the final design:

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 172017](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6mG7f89ZDOsngQ8qn0yp6oxaSBtp0k8c/152334212e438210fe509aaf52587aa545461388fb9813a203f08bc34013888f.png)

I encountered many issues about the shape's layouts and how they phase through but I am confident that this design will work and look good. The SVG file doesn't have the right parts that are filled in, but I think that my maker space will be able to change it in Lightburn.
